About Hooda Nutrition

Welcome to Hooda Nutrition! Founded by Vikas Joon from Delhi, with Neeraj Hooda as a brand ambassador, we are committed to providing only 100% genuine and authorized branded supplements.

As certified dealers in the fitness industry, our mission is to help fitness enthusiasts achieve their goals with safe and trusted products. We believe in quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction.

Whether you’re a beginner or a pro athlete, Hooda Nutrition is your trusted partner in health and fitness. Fuel your journey with us, because your body deserves nothing but the best.

FAQs

Are your products genuine?

Yes. We are certified dealers and sell only genuine, authorized branded supplements.

Is my order confirmed when WhatsApp opens?

No. Opening WhatsApp only prepares your message. Our team confirms availability, final shipping charges, payment instructions and delivery timeline after you send it.

Are the prices on the website current?

Yes. Prices and stock are checked again when you check out, and you are told if anything has changed.
